messages.subject: Segmentation fault with subjunc 1.5.0-p1
parts:
Hello,

I was mapping my gzipped fasq file using subjunc 1.5.0-p1 (compiled fro source) and getting this error SEGV11. I found this earlier thread and tried to use the unzipped file yet got the same error. Therefore there seemed to be a different cause. 

I created two smaller files from the original one and both smaller files ran fine. 

I used TAIR10 genome assembly as the reference, and my command was,

subjunc -T 16 -u -i subread_index -r input.fastq -o output.bam

Please let me know if you would like me to provide any other information. Thank you in advance for your help.

Best,
Chia-Yi
